Sweet Chili Chicken Freezer Burritos

Sticky sweet-chili chicken, creamy spicy rice and green onion tucked into freezer-ready burritos. Make a batch once, then crisp one up whenever you need a fast, filling meal.

Prep
Not listed
Cook
Not listed
Total
50 min
Difficulty
Not listed
Ingredients
9

Ingredients

  • 1⅜ kg (48 oz) boneless, skinless chicken thighs
  • Marinade: 180 g sweet-chili sauce, 90 g soy sauce, 30 g rice vinegar, 15 g sesame oil and black pepper
  • 240 g sushi rice (dry weight)
  • 200 g plain skyr or Greek yogurt
  • 30 g sriracha or gochujang
  • Salt and garlic, to taste
  • 10 large burrito tortillas
  • Finely sliced green onions
  • Optional toppings of choice

Amounts are scaled from 10 original servings. Season to taste.

Instructions

  1. Whisk sweet-chili sauce, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil and black pepper. Cut chicken into bite-size pieces, coat in the marinade and chill for at least 20 minutes (or overnight).
  2. Cook sushi rice according to the package. Stir together skyr or Greek yogurt and sriracha; season with salt and garlic, then fold through the warm rice.
  3. Cook chicken in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned and 165°F (74°C) inside. Add the marinade and simmer until glossy and sticky, stirring often.
  4. Warm tortillas so they roll easily. Divide spicy rice and chicken among 10 tortillas; add green onion and any extra toppings.
  5. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Cool completely, then wrap each burrito and freeze.
  6. To reheat from frozen, wrap in a paper towel and microwave for 2 minutes, then air-fry at 375°F (190°C) for 6–8 minutes to crisp, or pan-fry until hot throughout.

Cook times may vary when changing batch size.
